beats.say: Ireland Crime Explorer maps official recorded crime figures from the Central Statistics Office.
beats.caption: Official recorded-crime figures, mapped

beats.say: Every Garda Division on one map. Circle size is the number of incidents recorded.
beats.caption: 28 Garda Divisions · circle area = recorded incidents

beats.say: Tap an area for its own count, and how that changed.
beats.caption: Tap an area for its own numbers

beats.say: Filter by offence, right down to the official sub-categories.
beats.caption: Filter by offence — and by sub-category

beats.say: Compare any two years, back to twenty nineteen.
beats.caption: Compare any two years

beats.say: Local news coverage sits beside the area it belongs to.
beats.caption: Local reporting, pinned to the area

beats.say: And Dublin breaks down into forty one station areas.
beats.caption: Dublin · 41 station areas

beats.say: It also says plainly what it is not. Recorded crime is not the same as crime. Reporting rates and Garda activity move these counts too.
beats.caption: Recorded crime is not the same as crime

beats.say: Ireland Crime Explorer. Recorded crime, in context.
beats.caption: Recorded crime, in context
